== Ingredients ==
* [[cookbook:Butter|Butter]]
* [[cookbook:Egg|Eggs]]
* [[cookbook:Salt|Salt]] and [[cookbook:pepper|pepper]]
* [[cookbook:Cream|Cream]] (optional)
* [[cookbook:Cheese|Cheese]] (optional)
* [[cookbook:Breadcrumbs|Bread crumbs]] (optional)
== Procedure ==

# Butter a shirred egg dish (a small [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|casserole]] or [[Cookbook:Ramekin|custard dish]]).
# Put the dish on a low heat to melt the butter, or just add 2–3 tsp cream.
# Break an egg in the dish over the cream and season with salt and pepper. 
# Optionally, sprinkle with shredded cheese and/or bread crumbs.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in the oven at 375°F long enough to set the whites of the eggs. Alternatively, cook by placing the dish directly on low heat.
# Serve in the same dish.
